scope: All 2,514 original capture URLs plus eight separately captured public pagination pages. Full-height offline browser replay of every available HTML pair.
interpretation: Counts are signals per URL, not distinct defects. No unexplained content, reference, fragment, asset or screenshot-coverage differences remain. Pixel differences remain visible review signals: they include intentional form notices, code/plugin repairs, removed host warnings, restored content and unavailable-image placeholders. The report does not claim that every pixel difference was manually reviewed.
resolved_confirmed_items: Missing response anchors and inherited missing comment targets
Transcript and downloaded HTML encoding errors
Original /search/ article alias overwritten by archive search
Duplicate form IDs and broken shortcode excerpts
Malformed internal/external links, attachment feed query routing and original homepage pagination
Missing public attachment display pages and two recoverable external image dependencies
Audit screenshots clipped to the viewport instead of the measured page height

reviewed_computed_style_signals.explanation: Restoring literal HTML code fixes malformed nesting that originally pulled the sidebar and footer into article typography.
The original executable example navigates to a blocked destination during offline replay. The archive displays the script as code and retains the article theme.

interaction_checks: Search query and results under project prefix
Original search alias, first page, and preserved pagination
Contact form remains visible and inert
Embedded undo, delete, checkbox and reset
Long code no longer overflows the page
UTF-8 transcript and restored UTF-16 HTML
Attachment RSS alias returns ten posts as XML
additional_interactions: Original PNG renders all four rounded corners with no failed resource requests
Local undo drag ordering and keyboard reset work offline with no requests
Local CSS button demo remains interactive without navigation or requests

limitations: Browser replay cannot verify third-party video availability or uncaptured remote scripts.
Recovered external images reconstruct baseline dependencies; they are labeled in browser evidence.
Pixel differences include intentional changes and are review signals, not automatic failures.
Controls are inspected, not clicked; demo behavior still needs interaction tests.
Generated clone-only pages are inventoried separately; existing verify.py validates their local links.
DOM checks use HTML5 parsing; text expectations use an independent literal-fragment comparison.
Live refresh detects drift and saves separate responses; it does not replace the baseline comparison.

review_status.explanation: This historical run was not a passing visual audit. The zero-unexplained count excluded 802 unresolved visual findings, including the table-cell article. Do not interpret it as visual equivalence.
